name: tech-stack
title: Tech Stack
author: AlgorizeTech
description: The tools a product is built with: a label, then one group of marks at a time in two rows — an odd group as three over four — each mark blurring out and the next group blurring in. Use it as the "Built with" line in a hero or footer.
docs: Named exports: TechStack, TechStackGroup and TechStackTool. Compose it: holds children, each holding (icon is any node — an inline SVG or an ). One group shows at a time and gives way to the next every `interval` ms (default 3600; 0 holds the first), only while on screen; with prefers-reduced-motion the swap is a cut. `variant` is labelled (label on the left, names beside marks from xl up) or compact (label centred between hairlines, marks only, names as tooltips and screen-reader text). `label` takes any node. Four to eight tools per group read well. Colours are theme tokens.
